nodes.question: According to Pink (2012), why is it important to use theoretical tools of practice and place in understanding everyday life?
nodes.answer: Pink identified value in using the theoretical tools of practice and place to understand how innovation, change, and activism develop in everyday life, which can reveal how improved sustainability practices may be leveraged.
